meta.name: cc
meta.description: Sync cc-settings with upstream Claude Code (maintainer) or pull the latest cc-settings (user). Triggers "sync with claude code", "changelog sync", "upstream sync" (sync mode); "update cc-settings", "refresh my install" (update mode).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 同步 Claude Code 配置到最新版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 Claude Code 并希望配置保持最新。
copy.tagline_en: Sync your Claude Code settings with the latest upstream version.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Claude Code and want to keep settings up-to-date.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以按指令将 cc-settings 仓库与上游 Claude Code 同步（维护者模式），或从远程拉取最新 cc-settings 更新本地安装（用户模式）。
howto.when: 当你说出“sync with claude code”、“update cc-settings”、“refresh my install”等关键词时触发。

say.note: 启动sync模式，检查上游变更并提出采纳计划。
启动update模式，拉取最新版本并安装。

say.text: 使用sync模式，检查Claude Code更新。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can sync the cc-settings repo with upstream Claude Code (maintainer mode) or pull the latest cc-settings to update your local install (user mode), based on your command.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like "sync with claude code", "update cc-settings", "refresh my install", etc.

say_en.text: Sync cc-settings with upstream Claude Code.
say_en.note: Starts sync mode, reviews upstream changes and proposes an adoption plan.
Starts update mode, pulls latest version and installs.

say_en.text: Use sync mode to check Claude Code updates.
say_en.note: Starts sync mode, compares manifest vs npm version.
